questions.question: Please define audience source/methodology. If you build proprietary audiences, please include sources and seeds.
questions.approved_answer: PulsePoint builds proprietary audiences using a combination of first-party HCP data, de-identified medical and pharmacy claims, and real-time behavioral and contextual signals. PulsePoint's HCP data is built on Medscape first party data. We rely on Medscape CRM as the source because re-identification requires a consented foundation-- something only Medscape provides at scale. DTC audiences are derived from millions of annual claims and enriched with engagement and content consumption signals using our patented contextual engine mapped to National Library of Medicine's taxonomy. Data use is governed by strict contracts, population thresholds, and internal audits to meet both global and state-level health data requirements.
